hypothesis: 315 of 830 training rows belong to repeated approximate families (up to 5 rows). Equal family contribution, and family-aware class weights, may improve minority-source generalization compared with counting every row equally. No label/split expansion or relaxed adoption gate.
weights: Within each fit, sample weight inverse group size, normalized to mean 1. For family_class_v2, also balance class MASS under family weights rather than raw row count; remove automatic class_weight to avoid double weighting.
cv: same three original-training-only StratifiedGroupKFold 42 folds; all group sizes/class masses computed inside the respective training fold.
selection: Require >=0.005 macro F1 improvement on BOTH pooled grouped OOF and original validation; rank eligible by OOF; otherwise retain v2.
test: Previously observed 275-row holdout excluded from selection; no rescore if baseline retained. If adopted, serialize selection first and perform one descriptive refit comparison only.
disclosure: Repeated development on observed TASTY corpus. Source title/clone grouping approximates rather than proves problem independence; rare-class support remains small.
